description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Lion (Water)], and [Damage Cap +10000]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Lion (Water)
description.text: Increases [Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Lion after using two Water abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Lion
description.text: Causes [ATK and DEF -70%]/[ATK, DEF, RES -70%] and grants [Water Damage +10%]/[Prismatic Damage +10%] to party with 0/4+ XI members in party

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
